purpose: Provide same-individual absolute 2C DNA-content QC for R1B reference-transferability and later structural interpretation; not a phenotype-causality test.

public_context.genus_evidence: Diploid Cirsium with 2n=34 can differ substantially in 2C DNA content; chromosome count is not a sufficient proxy for genome size.

assay.tissue: fresh young leaf preferred; archive a paired tissue/voucher link to the same individual
assay.internal_standard_initial_candidate: Solanum lycopersicum, working value 2C=2.0 pg, matching the 2026 East-Asian Cirsium study
assay.standard_selection_rule: Run a sample-only and standard-only pilot at the same voltage, then a co-preparation. If G1 peaks overlap or cannot be unambiguously separated, switch to a validated alternative internal standard with better peak separation; do not force the tomato standard.
assay.replicate_disagreement_rule: If independent 2C estimates differ by >3%, run at least one additional independent preparation; if a stable estimate cannot be obtained without violating the peak-CV rule, code FLOW_2C_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.
assay.conversion_for_reporting: 1 pg ≈ 978 Mb; report 2C pg and derived 1C Mb, but retain raw fluorescence ratios and FCS files as primary records.

use_in_r1b: Test whether callable fraction, normalized depth, allele balance or reference sensitivity covary with same-individual 2C.
Flag multimodal or unexpectedly broad 2C distributions before interpreting genomic structure.
Use 2C as a QC covariate and stratification variable, not as a causal explanation of capitulum phenotypes.
prespecified_heterogeneity_flag: After measurement QC passes, if the between-individual 2C range exceeds 5% of the cohort median and is larger than replicate measurement dispersion, raise GENOME_SIZE_HETEROGENEITY_FLAG and inspect clustering before pooling individuals.
prohibited_inferences: Do not infer equivalent genome architecture from 2n=34.
Do not infer polyploidy from a small continuous 2C shift without chromosome/ploidy evidence.
Do not infer phenotype causation from 2C association.
Do not exclude an individual solely because its 2C differs unless the exclusion rule was independently justified by assay failure or a prespecified cytotype stratum.
source_basis: Bures et al. 2004, Annals of Botany 94:353-363, DOI 10.1093/aob/mch151
Dolezel, Greilhuber & Suda 2007, Nature Protocols 2:2233-2244, DOI 10.1038/nprot.2007.310
Chang et al. 2026, BMC Plant Biology, DOI 10.1186/s12870-026-08097-6
Reference standards for flow cytometric estimation of absolute nuclear DNA content in plants (2021 review)
